completed_steps.summary: Classified repository as a multi-part Docker Compose system with backend, mobile, backoffice, infrastructure, scripts, docs, and planning artifacts.
Inventoried existing docs under docs, code/docs, and _bmad-output/planning-artifacts; existing docs were mostly onboarding, historical audits, diagrams, ADRs, and evidence.

Extracted technology stack from pyproject.toml, package.json files, docker-compose.yml, Dockerfiles, Nginx config, FastAPI routers, SQLAlchemy models, Alembic migrations, React route maps, and scripts.
Scanned backend modules, API namespaces, KYC workflow, auth/RBAC, data models, Celery jobs, mobile routes, backoffice routes, deployment paths, and operations scripts.
Generated project overview, architecture, source tree, API, data model, component inventory, development, deployment, operations, and maintainer handbook documents.
Updated docs/index.md with a primary maintainer documentation section and generated project-parts.json metadata.
Validated JSON metadata, generated Markdown link targets, generated file sizes, and ASCII-only content for newly generated Markdown and JSON artifacts.

technology_stack.backend: Python 3.11, FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy async, asyncpg, Alembic, Redis, Celery, SlowAPI, Sentry, PaddleOCR, DeepFace
technology_stack.mobile: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, TanStack Query, React Router, Workbox PWA, MediaPipe, Sentry, Vitest, Playwright
technology_stack.backoffice: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, TanStack Query, React Router, Recharts, Sentry, Vitest, Playwright
technology_stack.infrastructure: Docker Compose, Nginx TLS reverse proxy, PostgreSQL 17, Redis 7, Mailpit, Flower

findings.product_scope: VeriPass is a KYC onboarding, verified identity storage, and auth/eligibility guardrail for downstream BICEC mobile apps. DGI, Sopra Amplitude, and core banking integration are out of scope now and are not a planned future path. Downstream access should use OS-aware app links or app-store redirects.
findings.existing_documentation: Existing docs included onboarding-guide.md, ADRs, diagrams, delivery trackers, audit reports, test evidence, troubleshooting notes, and BMAD planning artifacts. The generated set adds a handover-grade maintainer documentation layer.

resume_instructions: Workflow is complete. Use docs/index.md as the entry point and docs/maintainer-handbook.md as the primary handover guide.
